steps.en: Install Scion, start its server and complete runtime, image and credential setup
steps.zh: 安装 Scion，启动服务并配置容器、镜像和凭据

steps.en: Links the project to the local Hub
steps.zh: 把项目关联到本地控制中心

steps.en: Name an agent and give it a task
steps.zh: 给 agent 起名并交代任务

steps.en: Runs the task in a container with an agent worktree
steps.zh: 在容器内执行任务，改动留在 agent 工作树

component.zh: 执行服务与 agent 配置包

value.en: Delegate repository work without manually creating each agent's container and workspace
value.zh: 派发仓库任务，不再手工搭建每个 agent 的容器和工作区
